theorems.name: Submission.cbrldvc_setIntegral_biUnion_le_mul_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (t : Set (Euclid P)) (B : Euclid P → Set (Euclid P)), t.Countable → (∀ x ∈ t, MeasurableSet (B x)) → t.PairwiseDisjoint B → μ (⋃ x ∈ t, B x) < ∞ → IntegrableOn g (⋃ x ∈ t, B x) μ → (∀ x ∈ t, ∫ y in B x, g y ∂μ ≤ θ * (μ (B x)).toReal) → ∫ y in ⋃ x ∈ t, B x, g y ∂μ ≤ θ * (μ (⋃ x ∈ t, B x)).toReal
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
